prompt: With arm1, try to grasp box1 on shelf_a; if the grasp fails, try again until it works, then put box1 on the table.
why: "Until it works" is a loop. RoboLang 1.5 failure handlers allow a fixed number of retries (decision 0033 F5), but no loop and no unbounded retry; 1.4 branches on world conditions only (decision 0027).
